segments.text: Netaji traveled aboard the German submarine U-180, navigating perilous wartime waters around the Cape of Good Hope.
Off the coast of Madagascar, he transferred to the Imperial Japanese Navy submarine I-29.
This historic underwater rendezvous was the only civilian transfer between two different submarines of two allied navies in World War II.
Arriving in the Far East, Netaji revived the vision of an armed Liberation Army to march on Delhi.
